reason: In src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py:501-505, GitHubInstallation.dispatch directly accesses integration.metadata["sender"]["login"] without guarding for missing keys. Because build_integration only sets metadata["sender"] when state.get("sender") is truthy (src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py:376-377) and ensure_integration overwrites metadata during normal pipeline completion without sender (src/sentry/integrations/pipeline.py:32-42), any active Integration lacking "sender" raises an unhandled KeyError resulting in an HTTP 500.
